cards.back:
The slow rise in the Earth's average temperature.
Bahasa Indonesia: pemanasan global
Example: Global warming is melting the ice near the North Pole.
cards.say: global warming. The slow rise in the Earth's average temperature. Global warming is melting the ice near the North Pole.

cards.back:
A gas that traps heat in the Earth's atmosphere.
Bahasa Indonesia: gas rumah kaca
Example: Burning coal sends greenhouse gases into the air.
cards.say: greenhouse gas. A gas that traps heat in the Earth's atmosphere. Burning coal sends greenhouse gases into the air.

cards.back:
The amount of greenhouse gases, such as carbon dioxide, that a person or thing produces.
Bahasa Indonesia: jejak karbon
Example: Cycling to school gives you a smaller carbon footprint than driving.
cards.say: carbon footprint. The amount of greenhouse gases, such as carbon dioxide, that a person or thing produces. Cycling to school gives you a smaller carbon footprint than driving.

cards.back:
The wide variety of living things in one place.
Bahasa Indonesia: keanekaragaman hayati
Example: Coral reefs have great biodiversity, with thousands of kinds of fish.
cards.say: biodiversity. The wide variety of living things in one place. Coral reefs have great biodiversity, with thousands of kinds of fish.

cards.back:
The protection of nature and wildlife.
Bahasa Indonesia: konservasi
Example: Conservation groups work to protect the last wild elephants.
cards.say: conservation. The protection of nature and wildlife. Conservation groups work to protect the last wild elephants.

cards.back:
Planting trees again where a forest was cut down.
Bahasa Indonesia: reboisasi, penghutanan kembali
Example: Reforestation helped the hills grow green again after logging.
cards.say: reforestation. Planting trees again where a forest was cut down. Reforestation helped the hills grow green again after logging.

cards.back:
To make something dirty or unsafe by adding harmful things.
Bahasa Indonesia: mencemari
Example: Oil can contaminate a river and harm the fish.
cards.say: contaminate. To make something dirty or unsafe by adding harmful things. Oil can contaminate a river and harm the fish.

cards.back:
Poisonous and harmful to living things.
Bahasa Indonesia: beracun
Example: Never pour toxic chemicals down the drain into the sea.
cards.say: toxic. Poisonous and harmful to living things. Never pour toxic chemicals down the drain into the sea.

cards.back:
The destruction of the places where wild animals live.
Bahasa Indonesia: hilangnya habitat
Example: Habitat loss is the main danger for many rare birds.
cards.say: habitat loss. The destruction of the places where wild animals live. Habitat loss is the main danger for many rare birds.

cards.back:
A flat device that changes sunlight into electricity.
Bahasa Indonesia: panel surya
Example: A solar panel on the roof powers the school's lights.
cards.say: solar panel. A flat device that changes sunlight into electricity. A solar panel on the roof powers the school's lights.

cards.back:
A tall machine that uses wind to make electricity.
Bahasa Indonesia: turbin angin
Example: The wind turbine turned slowly on the hill by the coast.
cards.say: wind turbine. A tall machine that uses wind to make electricity. The wind turbine turned slowly on the hill by the coast.

cards.back:
Able to be used many times.
Bahasa Indonesia: dapat dipakai ulang
Example: Bring a reusable bottle instead of buying plastic every day.
cards.say: reusable. Able to be used many times. Bring a reusable bottle instead of buying plastic every day.

cards.back:
A large amount of water covering dry land.
Bahasa Indonesia: banjir
Example: A flood covered the road after three days of heavy rain.
cards.say: flood. A large amount of water covering dry land. A flood covered the road after three days of heavy rain.

cards.back:
A giant sea wave, usually caused by an earthquake under the sea.
Bahasa Indonesia: tsunami
Example: The siren warned everyone to leave the beach before the tsunami arrived.
cards.say: tsunami. A giant sea wave, usually caused by an earthquake under the sea. The siren warned everyone to leave the beach before the tsunami arrived.

cards.back:
A seasonal wind that brings very heavy rain to parts of Asia.
Bahasa Indonesia: angin muson
Example: The monsoon brings the rain that fills the rice fields.
cards.say: monsoon. A seasonal wind that brings very heavy rain to parts of Asia. The monsoon brings the rain that fills the rice fields.

cards.back:
Grown without chemical sprays or artificial fertilisers.
Bahasa Indonesia: organik
Example: The farmer sells organic vegetables at the Saturday market.
cards.say: organic. Grown without chemical sprays or artificial fertilisers. The farmer sells organic vegetables at the Saturday market.

cards.back:
Not able to be replaced once it has been used up.
Bahasa Indonesia: tidak terbarukan
Example: Oil is a non-renewable resource, so it will run out one day.
cards.say: non-renewable. Not able to be replaced once it has been used up. Oil is a non-renewable resource, so it will run out one day.

cards.back:
Catching so many fish that too few are left.
Bahasa Indonesia: penangkapan ikan berlebihan
Example: Overfishing has left the bay almost empty of large fish.
cards.say: overfishing. Catching so many fish that too few are left. Overfishing has left the bay almost empty of large fish.

cards.back:
When coral loses its colour because the sea water is too warm.
Bahasa Indonesia: pemutihan terumbu karang
Example: Coral bleaching turns the bright reef pale and weak.
cards.say: coral bleaching. When coral loses its colour because the sea water is too warm. Coral bleaching turns the bright reef pale and weak.

cards.back:
A layer of gas high in the sky that protects us from harmful rays from the Sun.
Bahasa Indonesia: lapisan ozon
Example: The ozone layer blocks most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet rays.
cards.say: ozone layer. A layer of gas high in the sky that protects us from harmful rays from the Sun. The ozone layer blocks most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet rays.

cards.back:
A person who hunts wild animals illegally.
Bahasa Indonesia: pemburu liar
Example: Rangers caught a poacher setting traps in the national park.
cards.say: poacher. A person who hunts wild animals illegally. Rangers caught a poacher setting traps in the national park.

cards.back:
Travel that aims to protect nature and help local people.
Bahasa Indonesia: ekowisata
Example: Ecotourism pays local guides to care for the mangrove forest.
cards.say: ecotourism. Travel that aims to protect nature and help local people. Ecotourism pays local guides to care for the mangrove forest.

cards.back:
Something useful that people can use, like water or wood.
Bahasa Indonesia: sumber daya
Example: Fresh water is a precious resource in dry places.
cards.say: resource. Something useful that people can use, like water or wood. Fresh water is a precious resource in dry places.
